description: This file implements an in-memory resource management service with CRUD operations, designed for use within a Node.js backend application. It provides functions to reset, list, create, read, update, and remove resource objects stored in memory.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the in-memory data store and counter, useful for testing.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns all resource objects stored in-memory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new resource object and adds it to the in-memory store with a unique ID.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves a resource object by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing resource object by its ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a resource object from memory by its ID.
